| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Sigma** `sigma` | 1.5 | 0.5 to 5 px | The size of the Gaussian blur in the first stage. The blur is cut at 4 sigma. |
| **Low threshold** `low` | 40 | 1 to 1530 | Thinned gradient values at or above this are weak edges, kept only when joined to a strong edge. |
| **High threshold** `high` | 100 | 1 to 1530 | Thinned gradient values at or above this are strong edges. If it is below the low threshold, the low threshold is used. |
| **Magnitude norm** `norm` | L2 (square root of the sum of squares) | L2 (square root of the sum of squares), L1 (sum of absolute values) | How Gx and Gy are combined into the gradient magnitude. |
| **Stage** `stage` | 5. Edges after hysteresis | 1. Smoothed image, 2. Gradient magnitude, 3. After non-maximum suppression, 4. Double threshold, 5. Edges after hysteresis | Which stage to show. The double threshold shows strong pixels as 255 and weak ones as 128. |
| **Output mapping** `outputMapping` | Stretch to full range | Absolute value, Offset by 128, Stretch to full range, Clip to 0 to 255 | How signed results, such as gradients, become 8-bit pixel values. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | Brightness only | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
